subject: Collapsed boxes: Bug or Design Decision?

messages.author: 3ac79f38018b3750
messages.subject: Collapsed boxes: Bug or Design Decision?
parts: When a box in ui.R contains a server generated valueBox or infoBox the output HTML is only generated when collapsed=FALSE. When the container box is collapsed by default, the valueBox or infoBox is missing when the box is expanded.

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Collapsed boxes: Bug or Design Decision?
parts:
That sounds like a bug. I think it's been reported here:
https://github.com/rstudio/shinydashboard/issues/42
On Thu, May 14, 2015 at 10:36 AM, Joe DeWitt <joejd...@gmail.com> wrote:

When a box in ui.R contains a server generated valueBox or infoBox the output HTML is only generated when collapsed=FALSE. When the container box is collapsed by default, the valueBox or infoBox is missing when the box is expanded.
